svg.title: ISO 1219-1 basic symbols – legend sheet for guide 29 (example)
svg.text: ISO 1219-1 basic fluid-power symbols – legend sheet (simplified teaching versions)
Read a circuit like a sentence: energy (pump) → control (valves) → work (cylinder / motor) → back to tank. Symbols show FUNCTION, not construction or size.
opens at set p, ext. drain
Port letters: P pump · T tank · A, B work ports · X, Y pilot / drain · L leak. Valve name x/y = x ports / y positions.
Unpowered (normal) position = the box next to the spring. Draw the circuit in that rest state.
Full standard: ISO 1219-1 (symbols), ISO 1219-2 (circuit diagrams). App legend: /?hyitem=1&hlel=legend#hyd
